title: 棒人間の仕事いろいろ
subject_en: the SAME friendly stick figure at work: a round head in warm cream (#FFF6E0, never pure white) with a closed black outline, dot eyes and a simple mouth, body and limbs as thick uniform black lines, a single blue necktie as the only accent colour; props are drawn with the same thick black line and may use the same blue. Each item is a separate small scene with one figure (two figures only where stated).
lead: プレゼン、会議、電話、握手、ひらめき、残業。資料やマニュアル、社内の掲示にそのまま使える、棒人間の仕事の場面12点。
items: pointing at a blank whiteboard on a stand
two stick figures sitting at a small table facing each other
holding a phone to the ear, other hand raised
sitting at a desk typing on a laptop
standing with one finger up and a light bulb above the head
running with a briefcase, motion lines
standing with a hand on the chin and a small empty thought bubble
sitting on a chair holding a mug with steam
slumped at a desk with a laptop and a crescent moon above
